about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Commemoration of the Baptism of Our Lord Jesus Christ” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May Thy heavenly light, we beseech Thee, O Lord, ever and everywhere go before us, that we may behold with a pure gaze and receive with a worthy disposition the mystery in which Thou hast willed us to share. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
